facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; large payments only need an after-the-fact report.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: hold foreign deposit accounts freely, even abroad.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: File a business-opening notice (kaigyō todoke) at your tax office within a month.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 5–45%, plus surtax and about 10% local tax.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 10% consumption tax above ¥10 million sales; exports zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: APPI applies to all businesses, including sole traders.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online goods can be cancelled within 8 days unless your terms say otherwise.
facts.L7_incentives: Blue Return: up to ¥650,000 deduction with double-entry bookkeeping.
facts.D1_id_document: My Number Card, driver's licence or passport.

watch_out.text: Japanese clients may need your invoice registration number, even below ¥10 million.
File the Blue Return application within two months to get the deduction.
